result.title: FewRef-5: Fixed-Reference Test-Time Adaptation for Virtual Staining
result.summary: Virtual staining synthesizes special-stain images from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E), extending the information available from an existing digital slide. However, a fixed inference rule can leave available real target-stain references unused, limiting query-specific correction of stain appearance at deployment. Test-time adaptation (TTA) provides a mechanism for this reference-guided, query-specific refinement without retraining the generator. We therefore propose FewRef-5, a reference-assisted TTA method for virtual staining built on StainPromptInversion. We extract tissue-masked optical-density means and standard deviations from five real Masson's trichrome (MAS) training patches and average them into a fixed stain target. A scheduled statistic-matching loss introduces this target into per-query visual-prompt optimization alongside our edge/Gram consistency penalties and the inherited reconstruction objectives. The target remains unchanged across queries, avoiding recursive dependence on earlier generated outputs while the pretrained generator stays fixed. On recorded H&E-to-MAS outputs for 1,989 queries, FewRef-5 reduces target-set FID from 183.201 to 166.904 and increases source-referenced SSIM from 0.92787 to 0.94996 relative to our Edge+Gram variant. Source PSNR and MS-SSIM decrease, showing an endpoint trade-off rather than uniformly better reconstruction.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FewRef-5，一种面向 H&E 到 MAS 虚拟染色的参考辅助测试时适配方法：从五个真实染色patch提取组织掩膜下的光密度均值与标准差并平均为固定染色目标，通过调度统计匹配损失与边缘/Gram 一致性约束，在冻结生成器上逐查询优化视觉提示。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「固定参考目标 + 测试时逐查询优化、避免递归依赖自生成输出」的做法，可能为 latent 推理中状态更新与误差累积/漂移控制提供可核查线索，但任务本身是图像翻译，无推理状态与证据使用。
